SENA DIWAS 2027 | A LEGACY OF VALOUR, A FUTURE OF STRENGTH
A saga of courage, sacrifice and unwavering commitment to the Nation. From historic battlefields to technology-driven warfare, the Indian Army continues to evolve, guided by its rich military heritage and the spirit of transformation.
As Bhopal gears up to host the Army Day Parade 2027, witness a celebration of military excellence, indigenous capabilities, operational prowess and the indomitable spirit of the Indian Soldier.
Honouring the Past. Transforming the Present. Securing the Future.
